title: Onboarding flow
description: Example assembly for the onboarding flow: welcome → profile-setup → plan-select → invite-team. It owns the navigation state the four screens refuse to hold — which step is on the route, the name carried from the profile back to the greeting, the photo picked for the avatar, the plan chosen and the invites sent — and it moves between them through the screens' own callbacks: Continue, a saved profile, a chosen plan and each Skip for now move one step forward, and a plain left click on a skip link is routed while a modified click is left to the browser. Rewrite it against your own router and API; the screens under it stay presentational.
